column1: # Single row for the player ship. Edit to retune; refresh npm run dev to see changes.
#   thrustAcceleration     — Acceleration each second thrust is held (px/s²).
#   thrustFlameLength      — Flame length multiplier relative to ship size.
#   thrustFlameColor       — Thrust flame colour as 0xRRGGBB (hot orange).
#   thrustFlameInnerColor  — Inner flame colour as 0xRRGGBB (bright yellow).
#   frictionDeceleration   — Linear deceleration when no thrust held (px/s²).
#   asteroidsRotationSpeed — Rotation speed in rad/s for asteroids scheme.
# To change ship tuning: edit the values in this row. No code edit required.
